expression.label: laughing, eyes open — 소리내어 웃는 · 눈 뜬 채

scene.value: An empty seaside roller-skating promenade at bright sunrise. She glides slowly on four-wheel skates with one leg stepping forward and both arms spread at waist level for balance, hands open and fingers separate, laughing toward the camera. Peach sky, wooden railings, a clear full-body silhouette.

outfit.value: A coral racerback athletic crop top with cream side panels, lime-green short pleated sports skirt over opaque fitted shorts, ivory socks and coral quad skates. Bare shoulders, midriff and legs; a tiny leaf bracelet, no armor.

custom.value: One clearly adult woman in her 20s. Both hands fully within the chosen framing, each hand exactly one thumb and four individually separated fingers with coherent knuckles; no fused digits or extra fingers. No weapons, text, logo, border or duplicate figure.
